sources.title: Prompt Engineering: A Comparative Study of Prompting Techniques in AI ...
sources.snippet: Prompt engineering plays a pivotal role in leveraging the full potential of large language models. This research paper focuses specifically on a comparative analysis of zero-shot and multi-shot prompting techniques, two widely used approaches in prompt engineering.
